audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Sett levels 1 and 2 and gave Nautilus nothing, contradicting both the packet chart and the whys text (which says level 1 is Nautilus' clean tap-trade and level 2 a coinflip).
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Nautilus, Skill, Sett, Sett, Sett, Sett, Skill. Sett has no Grit stored and no Facebreaker at level 1, so the passive root wins the tap-trade.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Nautilus, Skill, Sett, Sett, Sett, Sett, Skill with matching ratings.

audit.why: Spikes are level 1 root trade, level 3 stored Haymaker, level 6 The Show Stopper, 2+ items even engage duel — consistent with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text says Sett 'dashes in, suppresses you' with his R. Riot's text has no dash and no suppression: The Show Stopper is a 400-range carry-and-slam that grounds the area. Facebreaker's conditional stun was never stated, and the Haymaker shield interaction was flagged missing.
audit.why: Riot text: Facebreaker 'pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him... If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned' (490 range, 10-16s). Haymaker banks damage taken as Grit, then shields and deals true damage in the centre only (12-18s).
audit.corrected: Stay off his far side so Facebreaker only slows; bait the Grit shield out before committing your burst; The Show Stopper grabs at 400 and grounds, it does not gap-close to you.

edits.before: His R dashes in, suppresses you, and slams you back into his team, hard-answering any forward Q you throw.
edits.after: The Show Stopper grabs at 400 range and slams you back into his team — never step up while your Q is on cooldown.

edits.before: Sett's R is the threat window — he dashes in, suppresses you, and slams you back into his team for a free kill if you're pulled forward on Q cooldown.
edits.after: The Show Stopper is the threat window — it grabs at 400 range and slams you into his team, and it grounds, so there is no dash out if you stepped up.

edits.before: This is Sett's stretch. Once his W is stored he wins the extended brawl with true damage and grit, and at 6 his R flips any forward Q on you — he dashes in, suppresses, and slams you back into his team. Never throw Q into him while his W is loaded and his R is up; you'll get pulled to him and eat the smash. Instead, use your Q-pull-into-passive-root-into-E-slow as a GANK setup with your jungler, not a 1v1 all-in. Bait his E grab — if he whiffs the pull-stun, his combo falls apart.
edits.after: This is Sett's stretch. Once Grit is stored he wins the extended brawl with centre true damage and a shield, and at 6 The Show Stopper grabs you at 400 range and slams you back into his team. Never throw Q into him while Haymaker is loaded and his R is up. Instead, use Q-pull into passive root into E-slow as a GANK setup with your jungler, not a 1v1 all-in. Bait Facebreaker — from one side it only slows, and it is down 10-16 seconds.

edits.before: Shield + true damage. Peel before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Grit shield and centre true damage — bait it out first, then commit. Down 12-18s.

edits.before: Track Sett's Haymaker: Shield + true damage. Peel before it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Haymaker banks your damage as Grit — bait the shield out, then Q-E + R inside its 12-18s window.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — Shield + true damage. Peel before it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sett Haymaker: 12-18s — a Grit shield with true damage in the centre. Bait it out before every engage. - Dredge Line: never spend it on chip. - Depth Charge: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: That is Sett's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every auto you eat becomes Grit for his shield — burst and leave, never brawl.

edits.before: Whiffing hook and walking forward anyway — your kill threat IS the hook; without it you are a slow shield.
edits.after: Facebreaker stuns only with enemies on both sides — stay off his far side and you eat a slow, not a stun.

notes: Sett's W range reads 25000 in the kit — clearly a tooltip artifact, not used in any advice. Haymaker's shield-absorbs-burst missing interaction is now stated in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.
